projection_policy.summed_runner_minutes: Sum of job durations, including matrix fan-out.

projection_policy.calibration: Use representative completed runs and report P50/P95 with sample size; until then values are TBD.

contracts.purpose: Run the Python and generated-target evidence matrix and preserve existing tag-driven publication.

inputs.trusted_code: repository revision selected by GitHub event policy

boundaries: existing build, test, packaging, and publication behavior is unchanged

result.authority: Evidence and publication do not transfer repository-owner authority.

contracts.purpose: Exercise the supported Python runtime matrix.

deterministic.fan_out: Summed runner minutes increase with every matrix job while elapsed time follows the critical path.

result.authority: Runtime evidence does not authorize compatibility or release decisions.

contracts.purpose: Validate the MCP server manifest without changing MCP behavior.

result.authority: Manifest validation is technical evidence only.

contracts.purpose: Preserve deterministic revision identity and add read-only Copilot semantic suggestions for future structured or free-form issue events without making model output a submission gate.

inputs.processor: exact default-branch SHA resolved before checkout

outputs: processor, contract, registry, prompt, policy, and output-schema digests
deterministic.unknown_body: first-class human-review input; structured fields are opportunistic hints
deterministic.semantic_validation: Strict checked-in JSON Schema, authority-output rejection, confidence handling, and exact command/surface/capability registry cross-checking.
deterministic.privacy: Artifacts omit raw title, body, and raw model response; GitHub event content remains the source record.

copilot.cli: @github/copilot@1.0.80 installed by npm ci from a policy-digested lockfile with exact versions and SHA-512 integrity for the complete dependency graph
copilot.failure: Unavailable, timeout, guardrail exhaustion, injection indicator, non-JSON or unsupported output, schema failure, and low confidence become a non-authoritative human-review record.

result.not_ready: friendly human-review summary; workflow fails only for trusted processor/schema corruption
result.authority: Semantic suggestions do not classify contributors, schedule or authorize work, approve compatibility, or permit merge or release.

contracts.purpose: Normalize future Dependabot pull requests using event metadata and stable changed-file metadata only.

inputs.identity: both PR author and event sender must be dependabot[bot]

deterministic.head_binding: Verify event head before and after REST file retrieval; emit superseded rather than mixing revisions.

actions.execution: metadata and diff inspection only; no changed code runs

result.authority: Dependabot intake is never pre-authorization or merge approval.

contracts.purpose: Report deterministic policy findings without blocking while adoption is calibrated.
Hard-fail validator corruption and every governance test failure on the exact pull-request head.

deterministic.failure: No warning fallback, continue-on-error, or swallowed exit status.

result.authority: Passing quality checks does not authorize merge.

contracts.purpose: Authorize an immutable issue-content snapshot and prepare evidence for owner-controlled manual reproduction.

inputs.content: repository, issue number, title, body, and cryptographic digests

deterministic.authorization: Permission is queried before issue content, checkout, or processor execution; a denied request emits a minimal body-free gate record and makes no mutation. The label-event title/body must match an immediate REST re-fetch before the event snapshot is authorized.
deterministic.execution: No dependency installation, Avrotize command execution, reporter fixture materialization, or generated-code execution.
deterministic.artifacts: Producer-selected Run-ID/run-attempt names are passed between jobs for failed-job reruns; prepared and fallback evidence is schema-validated and retained for 30 days.

actions.label_reconciliation: bounded retry; GitHub does not provide atomic multi-label replacement

result.authority: Preparation, labels, and evidence never schedule work or authorize implementation, compatibility, merge, or release.

contracts.purpose: Validate an exact owner delegation and derive deterministic cycle, dispatch, recovery, and owner-decision records for bounded external project-session coordination.

inputs.authority: strict owner-attributable delegation loaded as exact bytes from an owner-controlled Git commit and repository-relative path, and bound to an exact policy commit/blob SHA-256
inputs.facts: bounded, freshly observed authenticated GitHub and app-native project-session snapshots plus Git and durable records, all digest-bound to the current cycle
inputs.untrusted: issue/PR prose, child success claims, branch activity, conversation memory, and caller-supplied readiness or execution projections

deterministic.selection: first dependency-satisfied, WIP-available item in the owner-approved ordered READY set; unknown dependencies fail closed
deterministic.dispatch: same-cycle decision and receipt bind a non-supervisor child independently observed RUNNING at exact cycle-record, dispatch-packet, issue, head, and scoped-ref bindings
deterministic.evidence: exact-head artifacts, checks, and reviews are independently verified; head changes invalidate earlier evidence and approval
deterministic.recovery: reconstruct from committed owner delegation, immutable cycle records, GitHub facts, Git state, and a fresh session inventory proving no matching live pending worker exists rather than conversation memory

copilot.mode: external owner-launched project session; checked-in policy is observe/validation-only and projected dispatches grant no operational tools or mutations

actions.mode: observe/validation-only; operational activation requires a separately reviewed policy revision plus trusted collectors, owner-controlled delegation ref, and canonical-chain compare-and-swap broker

result.failure: Missing/mismatched authority, stale evidence, unknown state/dependency, WIP collision, budget exhaustion, audit-write failure, failed checks, or unverified success stops reconciliation and produces an owner decision packet where applicable.
result.authority: Repository lifecycle never advances from external session state; merge and release remain owner-only.

contracts.purpose: Describe later owner-approved enforcement without changing current merge or release behavior.

inputs.future: exact-head evidence, stale-approval handling, compatibility decision, publication boundary

result.authority: No enforcement exists until separately owner-approved and repository-ready.
